author: Genshin Impact
text:
Teyvat Adventures Commemorative Video: 6th Anniversary Letter | Genshin Impact
From the breezes of Mondstadt to Natlan's blazing Sacred Flame, and onward to the moonlit north, our journey has now spanned six years.

Along the way, we followed the light of the lighthouse and came together on the Moon-Prayer Night.
We even set foot on the moon, finding love and moments that moved us through every meeting and every farewell.

The world continues to grow ever wider, and new stories still await us on the road ahead.
May you continue to walk this journey with us in the years to come.

Happy 6th anniversary, Traveler!
